_readme: Copy this file to config/credentials.json (already gitignored) if you want to change any defaults. Nothing here is required to run the app — real TikTok data is fetched out of the box via the built-in scraper, no account or key needed.
_dataProvider_options: tiktok (default, free, scrapes public TikTok pages with a headless browser) | rapidapi (paid, more reliable) | mock (offline demo data)
_maxVideosToFetch_readme: How many videos to pull per channel when scraping live. Higher = more complete history but slower and more likely to get rate-limited by TikTok. Very large/old channels may still only return their most recent videos without logging in — the dashboard will show a 'partial data' notice when that happens.
_nicheMaxVideos_readme: How many videos to scan per Niche Stats keyword search (the results page also lets you override this per-search up to 1000). Higher = better creator coverage but slower.
_scrapeHeadless_readme: Set to false to watch the scraper's browser window live (useful for debugging a channel that returns no videos — you'll see if TikTok is showing a CAPTCHA/verification page). Same as env var TIKTOK_SCRAPE_HEADLESS=false.
_scrapeDebug_readme: Set to true to log every TikTok API response the scraper sees to the terminal running `npm run dev` — shows exactly what TikTok returned. Same as env var TIKTOK_SCRAPE_DEBUG=1. See README 'Troubleshooting: no videos returned'.
_persistSession_readme: Set to false to disable. When true (default), the scraper saves its browser session (cookies/localStorage) to data/session-state.json after any successful scrape, and reuses it on the next one instead of starting a brand-new session every time. This does NOT solve or bypass any CAPTCHA/verification check automatically — it just means a session that already got past one (e.g. during a manual scrapeHeadless:false run, or just from normal repeated use) doesn't have to again as often. Same as env var PERSIST_SESSION=false.
_translateApi_readme: Used by the Settings page's 'Translate from English' button for Niche Finder search terms. Points at the free public LibreTranslate instance by default — self-host your own (see README 'Translating Niche Finder terms') and put its URL here for reliability. translateApiKey is only needed if your instance requires one. Same as env vars TRANSLATE_API_URL / TRANSLATE_API_KEY.

rapidApi._readme: Optional, more reliable alternative to the built-in scraper. Subscribe to a TikTok scraper API on RapidAPI (e.g. 'TikTok Scraper' / 'tiktok-scraper7') and paste your key below, then set dataProvider to 'rapidapi' above.

tiktokAccount._readme: Optional but strongly recommended — a cookie-less headless browser is the traffic TikTok is most likely to block or serve empty/verification responses to. TikTok blocks scripted username/password logins (captcha + 2FA), so raw credentials are NOT used to auto-login anywhere in this app; 'username' and 'password' are unused placeholders. What actually helps is 'cookie': the Cookie request header from a real browser tab that has visited tiktok.com (you do not need to be logged in — even an anonymous visit's cookies help, though a logged-in session helps more).
tiktokAccount._cookie_WARNING: IMPORTANT: real TikTok cookies (e.g. 'g_state') contain raw " and sometimes \ characters. If you paste the cookie directly here, you MUST escape every " as \" or this whole JSON file will fail to parse and ALL your settings (including this cookie) will be silently ignored. It is much easier and safer to skip this field entirely and instead set the TIKTOK_COOKIE environment variable in .env.local, which needs no escaping at all — see .env.example and the README.
